opening.text: I started getting anxious and having vivid dreams about two weeks after I began taking mefloquine. Since I came back, I've had mood swings where I get angry and irritable. I also have persistent 'sea legs,' a feeling as if I'm on a boat, and I get attacks of vertigo that each last 20 to 30 minutes.
